G5000.def:
Ταβειθά (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא), 
Tabitha: Actes 9:36, 40 (cf. Δορκάς).†

G5001.def:
τάγμα, -τος, τό
(τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] 
that which has been arranged or placed in order; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank: metaphorically, 1 Corinthiens 15:23 (see ICC, in l).†

G5002.def:
τακτός, -ή, -όν
(τάσσω), [in LXX: Job 12:5 (שַׁאֲנָן) * ;] 
ordered, fixed, stated: ἡμέρα, Actes 12:21,†

G5003.def:
ταλαιπωρέω, -ῶ
(ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;] 
__1. to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress: Jacques 4:9. 
__2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so Psaumes 17:9, Ésaïe 33:1).†

G5004.def:
ταλαιπωρία, -ας, ἡ
(ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;] 
__1. hard work (Hippocr.). 
__2. hardship, suffering, distress: Romains 3:16 (LXX) pl., Jacques 5:1 (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153). 
(Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)†

G5005.def:
ταλαίωρος, -ον 
[in LXX: Psaumes 137:8 (שָׁדַד), Ésaïe 33:1 (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10, Wis.3:11, al. ;] 
distressed, miserable, wretched: Romains 7:24, Apocalypse 3:17.†

G5006.def:
ταλαντιαῖος, -α, -ον
(τάλαντον), 
__(a) worth a talent; 
__(b) of a talent's weight: Apocalypse 16:21.†

G5008.def:
ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr., 150), 
talitha, i.e. maiden: Marc 5:41.†

G5009.def:
ταμεῖον
(late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr., 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] 
__1. a treasury (Thuc., al). 
__2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; Deutéronome 28:8): Luc 12:24. 
__3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 Ésaïe 26:20, al.): Matthieu 6:6 24:26, Luc 12:3.†

G5010.def:
τάξις, -εως, ἡ
(τάσσω), [in LXX: Job 38:12 (מָקוֹם), Psaumes 110:4 (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18, al. ;] 
__1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.). 
__2. arrangement, order (Plat., al): Luc 1:8. 
__3. due order: Colossiens 2:5 (ICC, in l); κατὰ τάξιν, 1 Corinthiens 14:40. 
__4. office, order (for exx., see MM, xxiv): Hébreux 5:6 (LXX), Hébreux 5:6 6:20 7:11, 17" (LXX) .†

G5011.def:
ταπεινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;] 
low-lying; metaphorically, 
__(a) lowly, of low degree, brought low: Jacques 1:9, 2 Corinthiens 7:6 (cf. Sir.25:23); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, Luc 1:52; τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC, in l), Romains 12:16; 
__(b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., Syn., § xlii; but see also Abbott, Essays, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: 2 Corinthiens 10:1; before τ. καρδίᾳ, Matthieu 11:29 (cf. Psaumes 34:19); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, Jacques 4:6, 1 Pierre 5:5" (LXX) .†

G5012.def:
ταπεινοφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων) 
lowliness of mind, humility: Actes 20:19, Éphésiens 4:2, Philippiens 2:3, Colossiens 3:12, 1 Pierre 5:5; of a false humility, Colossiens 2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn., § xlii).†

G5013.def:
ταπεινόω, -ῶ
(ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;] 
to make low: ὄρος (βουνόν), Luc 3:5 (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase: Matthieu 18:4 23:12, Luc 14:11 18:14, 2 Corinthiens 11:7 12:21, Philippiens 2:8; pass., Matthieu 23:12, Luc 14:11 18:14, Philippiens 4:12; id. with mid. sense, Jacques 4:10, 1 Pierre 5:6.†

G5014.def:
ταπείνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] 
abasement, humiliation, low estate: Luc 1:48, Actes 8:33" (LXX), Philippiens 3:21, Jacques 1:10 (Plat., Arist., and later writers).†

G5015.def:
ταράσσω 
[in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;] 
to disturb, trouble, stir up: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, Jean 1:5 [4], Jean 1:7. Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex: Actes 15:24, Galates 1:7 5:10; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), Jean 11:33; of a crowd, to stir up, Actes 17:8, 13; pass., Matthieu 2:3 14:26, Marc 6:50, Luc 1:12 24:38, Jean 12:27 (Psaumes 6:4) Psaumes 14:1, 7, 1 Pierre 3:14" (LXX) ; τ. πνεύματι, Jean 13:21 (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω)

G5016.def:
ταραχή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for חָלָה, מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] 
trouble, disturbance: τ. ὕδατος, Jean 1:5 [4]. In pl. (as in cl.), tumults: Marc 13:8, Rec.†

G5017.def:
τάραχος, -ου, ὁ
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] 
later form of ταραχή (Xen., al.; see Thackeray, Gr., 159): Actes 12:18 19:23.†

G5019.def:
Ταρσός, -oῦ 
Tarsus, a city of Cilicia: Actes 9:30 11:25 22:3.†

G5020.def:
ταρταρόω, -ῶ
(Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned), 
to cast into hell: 2 Pierre 2:4 (see Mayor, in l).†

G5021.def:
τάσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;] 
primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order: with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), Actes 15:2 18:2 (διατ-, WH) Actes 22:10; ἑαυτούς, 1 Corinthiens 16:15; pass., Matthieu 8:9 (T [WH], R, txt., om.), Luc 7:8, Romains 13:1; ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον (perh. in mid. sense; see EGT and Page, in l), Actes 13:48; mid., to appoint for oneself or by one's own authority, Matthieu 28:16, Actes 28:23.†

G5022.def:
ταῦρος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹר ;] 
a bull: Matthieu 22:4, Actes 14:13, Hébreux 9:13 10:4.†

G5027.def:
ταφή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(θάπτω), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַר and cognate forms ;] 
burial: Matthieu 27:7 (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).†

G5028.def:
τάφος, -ου, ὁ
(θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;] 
__1. a burial (Hom., al.). 
__2. a grave, tomb (Res., Hdt., al.): Matthieu 23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1, Romains 3:13" (LXX) .†

G5029.def:
τάχα 
(ταχύς), 
adv., [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;] 
__(a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently; 
__(b) perhaps: Romains 5:7, Phm 15.†

G5030.def:
ταχέως
(ταχύς) 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;] 
quickly, hastily: Luc 14:21 16:6, Jean 11:31, 1 Corinthiens 4:19, Philippiens 2:19, 24, 2 Timothée 4:9; with suggestion of rashness, Galates 1:6, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:2, 1 Timothée 5:22.†

G5031.def:
ταχινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Proverbes 1:16, Habacuc 1:6, Ésaïe 59:7 (מָהַר), Wis.13:2, Sir.11:22 18:26 * ;] 
poët. and late for ταχύς, swift: of swift approach, 2 Pierre 1:14 2:1.†

G5032.def:
τάχειον, see: ταχύ.
ταχύ
(neut. of ταχύς), 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
quickly, speedily, forthwith: Matthieu 5:25 28:7-8, Marc 9:39, Luc 15:22, Jean 11:29, Apocalypse 2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jean 13:27 20:4, 1 Timothée 3:14 (T, Rec.), Hébreux 13:19, 23 Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), Actes 17:15.†

G5034.def:
τάχος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of מָהַר ;] 
swiftness, speed. Adverbially, ἐν τ. (ταχέως), quickly, speedily, soon: Luc 18:8, Actes 12:7 22:18 25:4, Romains 16:20, 1 Timothée 3:14, Apocalypse 1:1 22:6.†

G5035.def:
ταχύ
(neut. of ταχύς), 
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
quickly, speedily, forthwith: Matthieu 5:25 28:7-8, Marc 9:39, Luc 15:22, Jean 11:29, Apocalypse 2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jean 13:27 20:4, 1 Timothée 3:14 (T, Rec.), Hébreux 13:19, 23 Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), Actes 17:15.†

G5036.def:
ταχύς, -εῖα, -ύ 
[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
quick, swift, speedy: opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.†

G5037.def:
τέ, 
enclitic copulative particle (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in Ac. 
__1. τέ solitarium, and, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): Matthieu 28:12, Jean 4:42, Actes 2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21, al. 
__2. Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ . . . καί, τὲ καί, τὲ . . . τέ (Actes 26:16 Romains 14:8), as well . . . as also, both . . . and: Luc 12:45, Actes 1:1 15:9, 21:30, al.; τὲ . . . δέ, and . . . and, Actes 19:2; τὲ γάρ . . . ὁμοίως δὲ καί, Romains 1:26, 27.

G5038.def:
τεῖχος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;] 
a wall, esp. that about a town: Actes 9:25, 2 Corinthiens 11:33, Hébreux 11:30, Apocalypse 21:12-19 †

G5039.def:
τεκμήριον, -ου, τό
(τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: Wis.5:4 19:13, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] 
a sure sign, a positive proof: Actes 1:1-26 (for exx., see MM, xxiv).†
SYN.: ἔνδειγμα, q.v

G5040.def:
τεκνίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of τέκνον), 
a little child: as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., Jean 13:33, Galates 4:19, 1 Jean 2:1 Jn 2:12 Jn 2:28 Jn 3:7 Jn 3:13 Jn 4:4 Jn 5:21.†

G5041.def:
τεκνογονέω, -ῶ 
to beget or bear children: 1 Timothée 5:14 (Anthol.).†

G5044.def:
τεκνο-τροφέω, -ῶ 
to rear young (of bees, Arist.), 
to bring up children: 1 Timothée 5:10.†

G5045.def:
τέκτων, -ονος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;] 
an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): Matthieu 13:55, Marc 6:3.†

G5046.def:
τέλειος, -α, -ον
(τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;] 
having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect; 
__1. of persons, primarily of physical development, 
__(a) full-grown, mature: Hébreux 5:14; ethically: Philippiens 3:15; opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), 1 Corinthiens 2:6 14:20, Éphésiens 4:13; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, Colossiens 4:12; τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, Colossiens 1:28; 
__(b) complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on Jacques 1:4): Matthieu 5:48 19:21, Jacques 1:4 3:2; of God, Matthieu 5:48. 
__2. Of things, complete, perfect: Romains 12:2; ἔργον, Jacques 1:4; νόμος, Jacques 1:25; δώρημα, Jacques 1:17; ἀγάπη, 1 Jean 4:18; τὸ τ., 1 Corinthiens 13:10; compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), Hébreux 9:11. 
(There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. ICC on Colossiens 1:28; but see also Lft., in l, and Notes, 173 f.) † 
SYN.: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.)

G5047.def:
τελειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: Juges 9:16, 19 (תָּמִים), Proverbes 11:3 (תֻּמָּה), Wis.6:15 12:17, Jérémie 2:2 * ;] 
perfection, completeness: Colossiens 3:14, Hébreux 6:1

G5048.def:
τελειόω, -ῶ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: Exode 29:9, Lévitique 4:5, al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), 2 Rois 22:26, al. (תָּמַם), Wis.4:13, al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;] 
__1. bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil: Jean 4:34, Actes 20:24; of time, Luc 2:43, Jean 5:36 17:4; pass., ἡ γραφή, Jean 19:28. 
__2. to bring to maturity or completeness, to complete, perfect; 
__(a) of things: Hébreux 7:19, Jacques 2:22, 1 Jean 2:5 Jn 4:12 Jn 4:17 : 
__(b) of persons, in ethical and spiritual sense: Hébreux 2:10 9:9 10:1, 14; pass., Luc 13:32, Jean 17:23, Philippiens 3:12, Hébreux 5:9 7:28 11:40 12:23, 1 Jean 4:18 (for a different view of the meaning in Hébreux 2:10, al., see Rendall, in l).†

G5049.def:
τελείως
(τέλειος), 
adv., [in LXX: Jdth.11:6, 2Ma.12:42, 3Ma.3:26 3Mac 7:22, R* ;] 
completely, perfectly: 1 Pierre 1:13.†

G5050.def:
τελείωσις, -εως, ἡ
(τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, Exode 29:22, al. ;] 
fulfilment, completion, perfection: Luc 1:45, Hébreux 7:11.†

G5051.def:
τελειωτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(τελειόω), 
a consummator, finisher: Hébreux 12:2 (nowhere else).†

G5052.def:
τελεσφορέω, -ῶ
(τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;] 
__(a) of plants, to bring fruit to perfection (Theophr.): Luc 8:14 
__(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).†

G5053.def:
τελευτάω, -ῶ
(τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] 
__1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.). 
__2. Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die (Hdt., al.): Matthieu 2:19 9:18 22:25, Marc 9:48, Luc 7:2, Jean 11:39, Actes 2:29 7:15, Hébreux 11:22; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, Exode 21:17), Matthieu 15:4, Marc 7:10" (LXX) .†

G5054.def:
τελευτή, -ῆς, ἡ
(τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;] 
__1. a finishing. 
__2. an end: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): Matthieu 2:15.†

G5055.def:
τελέω, -ῶ
(τέλος), [in LXX for כָּלָה, pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to bring to an end, complete, finish: τ. δρόμον, 2 Timothée 4:7; τ. λόγους, Matthieu 7:28 19:1 26:1; τ. παραβολάς, Matthieu 13:53; τ. πόλεις, Matthieu 10:23; pass., Apocalypse 15:8 20:3, 5 20:7; with ptcp., Matthieu 11:1. 
__2. to execute, perform, complete, fulfil: Luc 2:39, Actes 13:29, Romains 2:27, 2 Corinthiens 12:9, Galates 5:16, Jacques 2:8, Apocalypse 11:7; pass., Luc 12:50 18:31 22:37, Jean 19:28, 30, Apocalypse 10:7 15:1 17:17. 
__3. to pay (frequently in cl.): Matthieu 17:24, Romains 13:6 
(cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-τελέω).†

G5056.def:
τέλος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;] 
__1. end: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), Luc 1:33, 1 Corinthiens 10:11, 2 Corinthiens 3:13, 1 Pierre 4:7; by meton., of one who makes an end, Romains 10:4; ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, 1 Corinthiens 1:8, 2 Corinthiens 1:13, Hébreux 3:14 6:11, Apocalypse 2:26; εἰς τ., to or at the end, Matthieu 10:22, Marc 13:13, Luc 18:5, Jean 13:1 (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, Luc 22:37; adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, 1 Pierre 3:8; of the last in a series, Apocalypse 21:6 22:13; of the issue, fate or destiny, Matthieu 26:58; with genitive of thing(s), Romains 6:21, al.; with genitive of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 11:13, al.; of the aim or purpose, 1 Timothée 1:5. 
__2. toll, custom, revenue: Romains 13:7; pl., as most usually, Matthieu 17:25

G5057.def:
τελώνης, -ου, ὁ
(τέλος, ὠνέομαι) 
__1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus). 
__2. A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): Matthieu 5:46 10:3, Luc 3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, Matthieu 9:10-11 11:19, Marc 2:15-16, Luc 5:30 7:34 15:1; τ. κ. πόρναι, Matthieu 21:31-32; ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., Matthieu 18:17 (cf. DB, iv, 172; ext., 394 f.; MM, xxiv).†

G5058.def:
τελώνιον, -ου, τό
(τελώνης), 
a custom house (so in MGr.), tollhouse, place of toll: Matthieu 9:9, Marc 2:14, Luc 5:27.†

G5059.def:
τέρας, -ατος, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for מוֹפֵת ;] 
a wonder, marvel: in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, Matthieu 24:24, al. (see: σημεῖον)

G5062.def:
τεσσεράκοντα (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 45 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl., 
forty: Matthieu 4:2, Marc 1:13, Luc 4:2, Jean 2:20, Actes 1:3, al

G5063.def:
τεσσερακονταετίς
(Τ, -έτης; Rec. τεσσαρ-, see supr.), -ές 
of forty years, forty years old: Actes 7:23 13:18.†

G5064.def:
τέσσαρες
(and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων, 
four: Matthieu 24:31, Marc 2:3, Luc 2:37, Jean 11:17 19:23, Actes 10:11, Apocalypse 4:4, 6, al

G5066.def:
τεταρταῖος, -α, -ον
(τέταρτος), [in LXX: 2 Rois 3:4 A (רְבִיעִי) * ;] 
of or on the fourth day: τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, Jean 11:39.†

G5067.def:
τέταρτος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX chiefly for רְבִיעִי ;] 
fourth: Matthieu 14:25, Marc 6:48, Actes 10:30, Apocalypse 4:7 6:7-8 8:12 16:8 21:19.†

G5068.def:
τετράγωνος, -ον
(τετρα-, see supr., + γωνία), [in LXX for רָבַע and cogn. forms ;] 
square: Apocalypse 21:16 (Hdt., Plat., al.).†

G5069.def:
τετράδιον, ου, τό 
a quarternion, a group of four: στρατιωτῶν, Actes 12:4 (Philo).

G5070.def:
τετρακισ-χίλιοι, -αι, -α 
four thousand: Matthieu 15:38 16:10, Marc 8:9, 20, Actes 21:38.†

G5072.def:
τετράμηνος, -ον 
[in LXX (neut.): Juges 19:2 A Juges 20:47 A (עַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים ) * ;] 
of four months, four months; as subst., τ. (sc. ὥρα, but neut. in Rec.), Jean 4:35 (Thuc., al.).†

G5074.def:
τετρά-πους, -ουν 
[in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה ;] 
four-footed: of beasts, neut. pl., Actes 10:12 11:6, Romains 1:23.†

G5075.def:
τετρααρχέω (Rec. τετραρχ-; see WH, App., 145), -ῶ 
(τετραάρχης), 
to be tetrarch: with genitive, Luc 3:1 (FlJ, BJ, iii, 10, 7).†

G5076.def:
τετραάρχης (Rec. τετράρχης, see supr.), -ου, ὁ 
(τετρα- in corp. = τέτορα, Doric for τέσσαρα, + ἄρχω), 
a tetrarch, i.e. 
__(a) prop., the governor of a fourth part of a region (Strab.); 
__(b) any petty ruler (Plut.); in NT, of Herod Antipas: Matthieu 14:1, Luc 3:19 9:7, Actes 13:1.†

G5077.def:
τεφρόω, -ῶ
(τέφρα, ashes; Wis.2:3, al.), 
to burn to ashes: 2 Pierre 2:6.†

G5078.def:
τέχνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX for חׇכְמָה, מַעֲשֶׂה, עֲבֹדָה ;] 
art, craft, trade: Actes 17:29 18:3, Apocalypse 18:22 (WH, R, mg., om.).†

G5079.def:
τεχνίτης, -ου, ὁ
(τέχνη), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;] 
a craftsman, artificer: Actes 19:24, 38, Apocalypse 18:22; of God (Wis.13:1), Hébreux 11:10.†
SYN.: δημιουργός, which see, and cf. Tr., Syn., § cv

G5080.def:
τήκω 
[in LXX for מָסַס ni., מָקַק ni., מוּג ni., etc. ;] 
trans., 
to melt, melt down; pass., to melt, melt away: 2 Pierre 3:12.†

G5081.def:
τηλαυγῶς 
adv. (τῆλε, afar, + αὐγή, radiance), poët. and in late prose, 
at a distance clearly: Marc 8:25 (W, mg., δηλαυγῶς).†

G5082.def:
τηλικοῦτος, -αύτη, -οῦτο
(altern. of τηλικόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε, strength­ened form of τηλίκος), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:3, 3Ma.3:9, 4Ma.16:4 * ;] 
__1. of persons, 
__(a) of such an age, so old; 
__(b) so young. 
__2. Of things, so great: 2 Corinthiens 1:10, Hébreux 2:3, Jacques 3:4, Apocalypse 16:18.†

G5083G.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Matthieu 27:36, Actes 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2 Corinthiens 11:9, 1 Timothée 5:22, Jacques 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jean 12:7, Actes 25:21, 1 Pierre 1:4, 2 Pierre 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jean 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jean 17:15, Apocalypse 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2 Timothée 4:7, Apocalypse 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Éphésiens 4:3. 
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jean 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Matthieu 19:17, Jean 14:15 15:10, 1 Timothée 6:14, 1 Jean 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Apocalypse 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jean 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1 Jean 2:5, Apocalypse 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, Actes 15:5, Jacques 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Marc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Apocalypse 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Apocalypse 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω) 
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word)

G5083H.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Matthieu 27:36, Actes 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2 Corinthiens 11:9, 1 Timothée 5:22, Jacques 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jean 12:7, Actes 25:21, 1 Pierre 1:4, 2 Pierre 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jean 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jean 17:15, Apocalypse 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2 Timothée 4:7, Apocalypse 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Éphésiens 4:3. 
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jean 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Matthieu 19:17, Jean 14:15 15:10, 1 Timothée 6:14, 1 Jean 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Apocalypse 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jean 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1 Jean 2:5, Apocalypse 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, Actes 15:5, Jacques 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Marc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Apocalypse 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Apocalypse 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω) 
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word)

G5083I.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Matthieu 27:36, Actes 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2 Corinthiens 11:9, 1 Timothée 5:22, Jacques 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jean 12:7, Actes 25:21, 1 Pierre 1:4, 2 Pierre 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jean 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jean 17:15, Apocalypse 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2 Timothée 4:7, Apocalypse 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Éphésiens 4:3. 
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jean 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Matthieu 19:17, Jean 14:15 15:10, 1 Timothée 6:14, 1 Jean 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Apocalypse 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jean 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1 Jean 2:5, Apocalypse 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, Actes 15:5, Jacques 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Marc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Apocalypse 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Apocalypse 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω) 
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word)

G5084.def:
τήρησις, -εως, ἡ
(τηρέω), [in LXX: Wis.6:18, (Sir.32:23), 1Ma.5:18, 2Ma.3:40, 3Ma.5:44 * ;] 
__1. a watching, hence, imprisonment, ward (see Deiss., BS, 267): Actes 4:3 5:18. 
__2. a keeping: τ. ἐντολῶν (cf. Sir, Wis, ll. with, and see Westc. on 1 Jean 2:3.), 1 Corinthiens 7:19.†

G5085G.def:
Τιβεριάς, -άδος, ἡ 
(Τιβέριος), 
Tiberias, a city of Galilee: Jean 6:23, Jean 6:1 21:1 (cf Γεννησσαρέτ, Γαλιλαία).†

G5085H.def:
Τιβεριάς, -άδος, ἡ 
(Τιβέριος), 
Tiberias, a city of Galilee: Jean 6:23, Jean 6:1 21:1 (cf Γεννησσαρέτ, Γαλιλαία).†

G5086.def:
Τιβέριος, -ου, ὁ, 
the Emperor Tiberius: Luc 3:1.†

G5087.def:
τίθημι, 
[in LXX for שִׁית ,נתן ,שׂוּם, etc. ;] 
__1. causative of κεῖμαι, 
__(a) to place, lay, set: Luc 6:48, Romains 9:33, al.; of laying the dead to rest, Marc 15:47, Luc 23:55, Jean 11:34, Actes 7:16, al.; before ἐπί, with genitive, Luc 8:16, Jean 19:19, al.; id. with accusative, Marc 4:21, 2 Corinthiens 3:13, al.; ὑπό, Matthieu 5:15, al.; παρά, Actes 4:35, 37. Mid., to have put or placed, to place for oneself: of putting in prison, Actes 4:3, 5:18, 25, al.; of giving counsel, βουλήν, Actes 27:12; of laying up in one's heart, Luc 1:66 21:14 ( 1 Rois 21:12); 
__(b) to put down, lay down: of bending the knees, τ. γόνατα, to kneel, Marc 15:19, Actes 7:60, al.; of putting off garments, Jean 13:4; of laying down life, τ. ψυχήν, Jean 10:11, 15 17, 18 13:37, 38 15:13, 1 Jean 3:16; of laying by money, παρ ̓ ἑαυτῷ, 1 Corinthiens 16:2; of setting on food, Jean 2:10; metaphorically, of setting forth an idea in symbolism, Marc 4:30. 
__2. to set, fix, establish: ὑπόδειγμα, 2 Pierre 2:6. 
__3. to make, appoint: Matthieu 22:44, Marc 12:36, Luc 20:43, Actes 2:35, Romains 4:17, al. Mid., to make, set or appoint for oneself: Actes 20:28, 1 Corinthiens 12:28, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:9, 1 Timothée 1:12, al.; before ἵνα, Jean 15:16 (cf . ἀνα-, προσ-ανα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἀντι-δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-τίθημι).

G5088.def:
τίκτω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָלַד ;] 
prop., of parents, 
to beget, bring forth, but esp. the latter, and so always in NT: absol., Luc 1:57 2:6, Jean 16:21, Galates 4:27" (LXX) (see M, Pr., 127), Apocalypse 12:2, 4; υἱόν, Matthieu 1:21, 23 1:25 Luc 1:31 2:7, Apocalypse 12:5, 13; pass., Matthieu 2:2, Luc 2:11. Metaphorical, of the earth, βοτάνην, Hébreux 6:7 (Æsch., al.); of lust, ἁμαρτίαν, Jacques 1:15.†

G5089.def:
τίλλω 
[in LXX: Esther 9:3, Ésaïe 18:7, Dan LXX 7:4 (מָרַט) * ;] 
to pluck, pluck off: στάχυας, Matthieu 12:1, Marc 2:23, Luc 6:1.†

G5090.def:
Τιμαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. טִימַי (?), see Zorell, see word), 
Timæus: Marc 10:46.†

G5091.def:
τιμάω, -ῶ
(τιμή), [in LXX for כָּבַד pi., עָרַךְ hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to fix the value, price: with accusative of person(s), of Christ, Matthieu 27:9 (LXX). 
__2. to honour: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 15:4 (LXX), Matthieu 15:5, 8" (LXX) Matthieu 19:19 (LXX), Marc 7:6, 10 10:19, Luc 18:28" (LXX), Jean 5:23 8:49 12:26, Éphésiens 6:2" (LXX), 1 Timothée 5:3, 1 Pierre 2:17; πολλαῖς τιμαῖς, Actes 28:10.†

G5092.def:
τιμή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for עֵרֶךְ, יְקָר, etc. ;] 
a valuing, hence, objectively; 
__1. a price paid or received: with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 27:9; with genitive of thing(s), Actes 5:2-3; pl., Actes 4:34 19:19; τ. αἵματος, Matthieu 27:6; ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς, 1 Corinthiens 6:20 7:23; ὠνεῖσθαι τιμῆς ἀργυρίου, Actes 7:16. 
__2. esteem, honour: Romains 12:10 13:7, 1 Corinthiens 12:23, 1 Timothée 5:17 6:1, Hébreux 5:4, 1 Pierre 2:7 (R, txt., preciousness, cf. Hort, in l), 1 Pierre 3:7; τ. διδόναι, 1 Corinthiens 12:24; ἔχειν, Jean 4:44, Hébreux 3:3; τ. καὶ δόξα (δ. κ. τ.), Romains 2:7, 10, 1 Timothée 1:17, Hébreux 2:7" (LXX), Hébreux 2:9, 1 Pierre 1:7, 2 Pierre 1:17, Apocalypse 4:9, 11 5:12-13 7:12 21:26; τ. καὶ κράτος, 1 Timothée 6:16; εἰς τ., Romains 9:21, 2 Timothée 2:20-21; ἐν τ., Colossiens 2:23; 1 Thessaloniciens 4:4; by meton., of marks of honour, Actes 28:10.†

G5093.def:
τίμιος, -α, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX chiefly for יָקָר ;] 
valued, hence, 
__(a) precious, costly, highly valued: primarily, of money value, λίθος, Apocalypse 17:4 18:12, 16 21:19; pl., 1 Corinthiens 3:12; compar., -ώτεφος, 1 Pierre 1:7, Rec.; superl., -ώτατος, Apocalypse 18:12 21:11; in extended sense, καρπός, Jacques 5:7; αἷμα, 1 Pierre 1:19; ἐπαγγέλματα, 2 Pierre 1:4; 
__(b) held in honour, honoured, esteemed worthy: with dative, Actes 5:34; ὁ γάμος, Hébreux 13:4; ψυχή, Actes 20:24 (where τ. is pleonastic, see Page, in l).†

G5094.def:
τιμιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(τίμιος), 
preciousness, worth: Apocalypse 18:19 (cf. Hort on τιμή, 1 Pierre 2:7).†

G5095.def:
Τιμόθεος, -ου, ὁ 
Timothy: Actes 17:14-15 18:5, Romains 16:21, al.

G5097.def:
τιμωρέω, -ῶ 
(τιμή + οὖρος, a guardian) [in LXX: Eze.5:17 14:15 (שָׁכֹל pi), Wis.12:20 18:8, al. ;] 
__1. to help. 
__2. to avenge; mid., to avenge oneself on, punish (Hdt., Eur., al): act, in this sense, Actes 22:5 26:11 (see MM, xxiv).†

G5098.def:
τιμωρία, -ας, ἡ
(τιμωρέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 24:22 (פִּיד), etc. ;] 
__1. help, assistance. 
__2. vengeance, punishment: Hébreux 10:29.†
SYN.: κόλασις, which see, and cf. MM, xxiv

G5099.def:
τίνω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 27:12 (τ. ζημίαν, for עָנַשׁ ni.), etc. ;] 
to pay: t. δίκην (cf. Pr, l.with), to pay penalty, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:9 (see M, Th., in l).†
